gaps.explanation: Re-read pp6-7 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, GAAP, Total revenues 7,431,158) and every schedule page (pp15-22). Every governmental fund column has its own schedule in detail and nothing is counted twice. Per fund, schedule vs statement column: General Fund departments p21-22 total 1,592,318 = General 1,592,318; Street budget schedule p15 total resources 1,660,209 vs Street column 1,636,947 (+23,262: sales tax 108,703 vs 98,243, special assessments 12,807 vs -, motor vehicle tax 62,298 vs 62,303); Airport p16 2,733,845 = 2,733,845; Infrastructure p17 648,034 vs 660,230 (-12,196: sales tax 631,450 vs 632,348, special assessments 14,184 vs 25,482); Economic Development p18 324,361 vs 324,660 (-299: sales tax 210,484 vs 210,783); Golf p19 467,152 = 467,152; nonmajor combining p20 16,006 = Other Governmental Funds 16,006. 23,262 - 12,196 - 299 = 10,767 = schedule above statement. The budget schedules (Street, Infrastructure, Economic Development) are printed on the budgetary basis; the difference is in the report itself. No line to add or remove.

Statement total expenditures 8,348,858 (p7). Per fund, schedule vs statement column: General Fund departments p21-22 2,008,546 = 2,008,546; Street budget schedule p15 total charges to appropriations 2,054,392 vs Street column 2,930,320 (-875,928: capital outlay 1,581,811 vs 2,415,615, public works 427,469 vs 470,458, interest 4,113 vs 3,248; principal 40,999 both); Airport p16 2,658,450 (operating 480,043 + capital outlay 2,178,407) vs Airport column 2,777,400 (Airport 503,403 + capital outlay 2,273,997) (-118,950); Infrastructure none / none; Economic Development p18 71,000 = 71,000; Golf p19 553,195 vs 556,542 (-3,347: environment and leisure 392,873 vs 396,523, interest 17,293 vs 16,990); nonmajor p20 5,050 = 5,050. 875,928 + 118,950 + 3,347 = 998,225 = gap. The Street, Airport and Golf schedules are budgetary-basis comparisons (capital outlay mostly), printed amounts lower than the GAAP fund columns. No fund column or row is missing (each column has its schedule; adding the statement column lines would count those funds twice). No line to add or remove.

Statement transfers in 626,326 = net by fund (p6 General 378,034 + Street 116,000; p7 Golf 132,292). Detail 859,339 = General Fund department transfers as printed on p21-22 (Administrative 495,416, Library 84,561, Park 31,070) + Street 116,000 (p15) + Golf 132,292 (p19). The department schedule prints Pool (233,013) separately; the statement General column nets it (495,416 + 84,561 + 31,070 - 233,013 = 378,034). 859,339 - 233,013 = 626,326. Gross vs net presentation in the report; nothing to change.

Statement transfers out 707,982 = Infrastructure 487,782 + Economic Development 215,200 + Other Governmental Funds 5,000 (p7). Detail 940,995 = those three (pp17, 18, 20) + General Fund Pool department (233,013) printed on p22, which the statement nets inside the General column. 940,995 - 233,013 = 707,982. Nothing to change.
